grh_675a599546e69d654e9e.title: When My Baby Smiles at Me
paragraphs: Burlesque partners Skid Johnson and Bonnie Kane marry and build an act together, but Skid's Broadway success, drinking and involvement with dancer Sylvia Marco pull him away from Bonnie and eventually break up their partnership.
